issue: The CHEST PAIN AE (2014-04-05 to 2014-04-09) is recorded with Hospitalisation = Y but Serious = N. Hospitalisation is normally a seriousness criterion, so these two fields disagree.
query_text: On the Adverse Events form, the event CHEST PAIN (start 2014-04-05, end 2014-04-09, mild, outcome Recovered/Resolved) has "Hospitalisation" recorded as Y while "Serious" is recorded as N. Please check this entry. If the patient was admitted to hospital for this event (or an existing admission was extended), please consider whether the event meets the protocol's definition of a serious adverse event, update the seriousness field and complete SAE reporting if needed. If the patient was not admitted, please correct the Hospitalisation field. Thank you.
